mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Community MCP servers available, but no official remote MCP server from Clearbit/HubSpot.

blockers_observed: API key issuance closed to new users since 2023

buildability_signal.notes: Legacy API endpoints remain functional for existing customers, but new integrators cannot obtain API keys. Clearbit is now sold exclusively as HubSpot Breeze Intelligence.

evidence.claim: Clearbit authenticates with API key via Basic or Bearer

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: The Semrush MCP is available across Semrush One, SEO Classic, and Trends API plans.

buildability_signal.notes: Well-documented API with multiple versions, official MCP server, and self-serve access. Strong integration potential.

evidence.claim: Semrush APIs use API key or OAuth 2.0

one_liner: Professional SEO toolset providing backlink analysis, keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, and competitive analysis via REST API.

auth.auth_notes: To send requests to Ahrefs API, you'll need an API key. Send your API key as a bearer token in the Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> header. Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE.
auth.access_notes: Only workspace owners and admins can create and manage API keys.

access.access_notes: Ahrefs API requires a paid subscription. API keys can be created by workspace owners and admins in Account settings.

api_surface.breadth_notes: Comprehensive API covering Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Batch Analysis, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, and more. Full OpenAPI specification available.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server. The remote MCP server uses Bearer token authentication with MCP-scoped keys. Legacy local server used API v3 keys.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Ahrefs MCP is available on Lite, Standard, Advanced, and Enterprise plans.

buildability_signal.notes: Official remote MCP server available. API keys and MCP keys are not interchangeable - need MCP-scoped key for remote server.

evidence.claim: Ahrefs API uses Bearer token authentication
evidence.quote: To send requests to Ahrefs API, you'll need an API key. Only workspace owners and admins can create and manage API keys.

evidence.claim: MCP uses different keys than API
evidence.quote: The hosted remote server is the opposite. It wants a key with MCP scope, which you generate separately in your Ahrefs account. Ahrefs states plainly that API keys and MCP keys are not interchangeable.
Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE).

research_notes: Ahrefs has official MCP server hosted remotely. API and MCP keys are separate - need to generate MCP-scoped key for remote server. Old local server archived.

one_liner: Sales automation and lead generation platform providing email finding, verification, drip campaigns, and CRM capabilities via REST API.

auth.auth_notes: Snov.io uses OAuth 2.0 client_credentials to obtain short-lived Bearer tokens. POST your API User ID (client_id) and API Secret (client_secret) to https://api.snov.io/v1/oauth/access_token to receive a Bearer access_token valid for 3600 seconds.

access.access_notes: Free plan available with limited credits. API access requires account with API User ID and Secret from account settings.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: Snov.io MCP uses OAuth 2.0 authorization_code with PKCE against an authorization server on app.snov.io, with open dynamic client registration and a single scope named 'mcp'.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Available on every plan including the free Trial. Consumes the same credits, recipients and LinkedIn slots as the rest of the platform.

buildability_signal.notes: Official remote MCP server available. MCP and REST API use different credential paths. MCP surface is larger than REST API surface.
buildability_signal.mcp_notes: MCP server exposes 100+ actions covering prospecting, CRM, and LinkedIn - more than REST API.

evidence.quote: You need to generate an access token to authenticate future requests. When making a request, please specify this access token in the Authorization field.

evidence.claim: MCP uses different auth than REST
evidence.quote: The auth model is inverted relative to most tools in this series. PhantomBuster MCP is OAuth with a per-user login and a workspace chosen at connect time. The REST API supports exactly one credential type: a workspace-scoped API key.

research_notes: PhantomBuster has official remote MCP server. REST uses API key, MCP uses OAuth. MCP is curated subset of REST capabilities.
